templates.models_from_nodes: If you pick a source project, models are also extracted from its nodes.

templates.cover_hint: Use Cover to choose which image appears on Explore cards. Up to 8 items.
templates.hub_purchased: Paid templates you bought from Explore.

templates.from_purchased_error: Failed to create project from purchase
templates.form_guide_body: Fill in a clear title, pick a category so the template appears in Explore filters, and add at least one preview image. After you save, submit the template for review from My templates so it can be published.
templates.guide_intro: On this page you fill in the template details and save it as a draft. It will not appear on Explore until you submit it for review and it is approved.
templates.guide_status_pending: Submitted and waiting for admin approval or rejection.
templates.guide_status_rejected: Not published; you can edit it and submit again.
templates.guide_fill_1: Set the title, template type, and category.
templates.guide_fill_2: Write the description and prompt text.
templates.guide_fill_3: Add AI models and a price if needed.
templates.guide_fill_4: Upload preview images or videos and pick the cover with the star.
templates.guide_after_1: The template appears in My templates as a draft.
templates.guide_after_2: Open the actions menu on that item and submit it for review.
templates.guide_after_3: After admin approval, the template is published on Explore.
templates.guide_cat_1: Category drives the horizontal filters at the top of Explore.
templates.guide_cat_2: If no category is selected, the template only appears under All.
templates.guide_cat_3: Tags are used for search and should be separated with commas.
templates.guide_example_body: Template “Enhance photo quality”, type Prompt + category “Image edit” + two preview images → save draft → submit for review → after approval, users see it on Explore and can use it.
templates.guide_note: Note: Saving this form does not publish the template. You must submit it for review from My templates.
templates.title_hint: The official name shown on the card and details page. Keep it short and specific.
templates.kind_hint: Prompt is text the user copies or uses. Workflow is for templates built from a Studio project with nodes.
templates.category_hint: Category drives the horizontal filters on Explore. If empty, the template only appears in All.
templates.tags_hint: Search the subject list and add a tag with + or Enter. Only these keys are saved.
templates.desc_hint: One or two sentences about the result. If the prompt is empty, this text is shown instead.
templates.prompt_hint: The main template text. For paid templates it stays hidden until purchase.
templates.models_hint: Models are loaded from the active provider list. You can add several; their display names appear on the template card.
templates.models_empty: No model selected yet. Optional, but it helps users know which model this template was built with.
templates.price_hint: 0 means the template is free and can be used immediately. Any amount above 0 makes it paid and hides the prompt until purchase.
templates.preview_hint: Select several files at once. Use the cover button to choose the Explore card image. Up to 8 items.
templates.form_note_create: After save the template is stored as a draft. Submit it for review from My templates so it can appear on Explore.
templates.form_note_edit: Saving creates a new version. After admin approval it replaces the previous published version.
templates.max_media: You can add up to 8 media items.
templates.max_media_remaining: Only {{count}} more file(s) can be added.

usage.title: AI usage
usage.subtitle: Model run costs, run counts, and image/video generation history in the studio.

usage.history_hint: Only runs that deducted from the wallet are shown.
usage.catalog_search_ph: Search model name (Enter or search icon)
usage.catalog_text_hint: Text models: Min and max columns show the cheapest and most expensive token rates.
usage.catalog_cache_hint: Models with context caching can cut input cost by about 50–80% on repeated prompts.
usage.catalog_image_hint: Image generation: usually priced per image. If there are quality or resolution tiers, min/max is that range.
usage.catalog_video_hint: Video generation: often priced by second. Min/max is the cheapest and most expensive recorded setting.
usage.catalog_audio_hint: Audio generation: usually priced per second or per character.
usage.catalog_subtitle: Search text, image, audio, and video models — price range (min to max) in USD.
